title: Listening
summary: Sentences to hear and type: short, long, with and without notes.
content:
## Listening

Hear a sentence, type it, and see it checked word by word. Sprint mode builds its listening exercises from the same sentences.

listening.text: El sol está muy fuerte hoy.
listening.meaning: The sun is very strong today.

listening.text: Hoy por la mañana vamos a la playa con mis dos hermanos y después comemos juntos en un restaurante pequeño cerca del mar.
listening.meaning: This morning we're going to the beach with my two brothers, and afterwards we'll eat together in a small restaurant near the sea.
